content.short: Plasma's native ve(3,3) liquidity marketplace for stable and volatile pairs.
content.description: Lithos is a DEX built for Plasma where holders lock its token for voting power and direct emissions to the pools they want deeper. Protocols bid for those votes to attract liquidity, and voters earn fees and incentives in return. Pools are tuned for both stablecoin pairs, which dominate Plasma, and volatile assets.
content.meta: Lock and vote on Lithos, Plasma's ve(3,3) DEX, to steer liquidity to stable and volatile pools and earn fees.
